name: Unicity
description: Unicity wallet identity, encrypted DMs, NIP-29 group chat and token payments via the Sphere SDK.

apiKey.label: Unicity API key
apiKey.help: Get one at https://sphere.unicity.network. Without it the wallet runs messaging-only (no payments).

strangerToolsAllow.label: Extra tools for non-owner turns
strangerToolsAllow.help: Dangerous: anything listed here is available to anyone who can message the agent.

nametag.description: Nametag to register for the agent's wallet (without '@').

owner.description: The human owner: a nametag (resolved and pinned on first start) or a 64/66-hex public key. Only the owner can use the wallet tools: on Unicity in DMs, never in Unicity groups. A sender OpenClaw recognizes as owner on another channel (commands.ownerAllowFrom) gets them there too, in that channel's group chats as well.

ownerPubkeys.description: Additional owner public keys (64- or 66-hex), e.g. for owner clients that sign with another key.

additionalRelays.description: Extra Nostr relay URLs for direct messages.

apiKey.description: Unicity gateway API key for the configured network; get one at https://sphere.unicity.network. Payments need it: without it the wallet runs messaging-only (DMs and groups).

walletApiUrl.description: Override of the configured network's wallet API URL. It belongs to that network: 'openclaw unicity setup' removes it when you switch networks.

dmPolicy.description: Who may DM the agent: 'open' (anyone; the default when unset), 'allowlist' (the owner and allowFrom), 'pairing' (unknown senders must be approved; paused while commands.ownerAllowFrom names no command owner), 'disabled' (nobody, the owner included). Covers DMs and wallet events only; groups are limited to those the owner joined or created. channels.unicity.dmPolicy takes precedence.

allowFrom.description: Nametags or public keys allowed to DM the agent under 'allowlist' (and pre-approved under 'pairing'). With 'open', any entry other than "*" restricts DMs to the listed senders.

strangerToolsAllow.description: Extra tools offered on non-owner Unicity turns (strangers' DMs, every Unicity group turn, incoming transfers and payment requests) on top of unicity_request_payment and unicity_list_groups (in groups unicity_list_groups only). DANGEROUS: anything listed is available to anyone who can message the agent; never add exec, file-system, sessions or message tools. Owner-only unicity_* tools, and unicity_request_payment in groups, stay blocked regardless: entries that would select one (a wildcard such as '*' or 'unicity_*', 'group:plugins', the plugin id) are ignored.

groupChat.description: NIP-29 group chat: true (network default relays), false (no group traffic at all), or { relays: [...] }.

unicity.label: Unicity
unicity.description: Encrypted Unicity DMs and NIP-29 group chats for the agent's wallet identity.

enabled.description: false disables the whole openclaw-unicity plugin, not only the channel: the wallet does not open and the wallet tools are not registered.
